name: Frostbridge Riddle
introText: A frozen canal splits the chamber. Narrow bridges and biting winds make every step a puzzle of timing.
successText: You cross the frost bridge as the ice settles behind you.
failureText: The ice groans and you are forced back to the entrance.

puzzleConfigs.question: Which month holds the deepest winter in the northern lands?

trapConfigs.intro: A hidden patch of thin ice cracks underfoot!
